# JOJO Papers

> Premier OEM & Private-Label Manufacturer for Pre-Rolled Cones, Rolling Papers, Filter Tips, and Custom Packaging. Made in India since 2014.

JOJO Papers specializes in high-volume, precision contract manufacturing for legal cannabis dispensaries, multi-state operators (MSOs), commercial filling operations, tobacco distributors, and global smoking accessories brands.

## Core Capabilities & Product Lines

- [Pre-Rolled Cones](https://jojopapers.com/pre-rolled-cones): Hand-crafted pre-rolled cones with integrated filter tips in 5 standard sizes (DogWalker 70mm, Mini 78mm, 1¼ Size 84mm, 98mm Special 98mm, King Size 109mm) and custom dimensions.
- [Bulk Cones](https://jojopapers.com/bulk-cones): High-count tower packs and stackable trays engineered for commercial vibration machines and high-speed filling lines.
- [Rolling Papers](https://jojopapers.com/rolling-papers): Premium rolling papers in 4 paper bases (Wood Pulp, Rice, Hemp, Flax) and 7 colour options (Unbleached Brown, Bleached White, Pink, Blue, Green, Purple, Black) in 1¼ and King Size Slim booklets.
- [Filter Tips](https://jojopapers.com/filters): Spiral and M-Shape tip constructions with precision airflow control, unbleached/bleached papers, and custom tip printing (Logo Only, Logo + Text, Pattern).
- [Retail & Packaging](https://jojopapers.com/retail-packaging): Custom booklet formats, magnetic closure boxes, slider drawer boxes, rigid paper tubes, embossed metal tins, counter display units, and master shippers.
- [Private Label & OEM Builder](https://jojopapers.com/private-label): Interactive 7-step product configurator to build and export production briefs for pre-rolled cones and rolling papers.
- [Quality Control & Consultation](https://jojopapers.com/consultation): Independent first-level quality control review in India, inspection checklists, and pre-shipment specification verification.
